name: IBM uRaman-Dataset: peak-normalized Raman reference spectra of three MOF compounds (HKUST-1, Mg-MOF74, ZIF-8)
description: Peak-normalized Raman reference spectra of the three MOF compounds listed in the deposit's README: HKUST-1 (Basolite C300, Sigma-Aldrich), Mg-MOF74 and ZIF-8 (Basolite Z1200, Sigma-Aldrich), measured with a WITec UHTS300S Raman system (DU970_BVF detector, 63x objective, 100 accumulations x 0.5 s). The acquisition conditions differ per compound (recorded in each folder's Experiment_Information.txt): HKUST-1 531.970 nm at 1 mW (2023-02-14), Mg-MOF74 632.810 nm at 1 mW (2023-03-01), ZIF-8 531.970 nm at 2 mW (2023-04-27); the Mg-MOF74 export is labelled '(Sub BG) (Norm)' (background-subtracted) and carries 989 negative points. All three spectra are peak-normalized (max = 1.0) as deposited, so the relative peak structure is comparable across the different excitation wavelengths and powers. The two native grids (1,806 points 0-3,997.65 cm^-1 for HKUST-1/ZIF-8, 2,768 points 0-3,998.38 cm^-1 for Mg-MOF74) are resampled with linear interpolation onto the common 0-3,997 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,998 points). This is a reference set: one stitched spectrum per class (3 classes), so no cross-validation-based classification is possible - the key is intended for spectral matching, few-shot and augmentation use. is_grouped=False (one spectrum per sample). The repo is served as a commit-pinned codeload archive (commit 47e712d326fb0458ee8218ab73a2cfc269dcdfab, 2023-06-19, 819,336 bytes, size + sha256 pinned); no indexed parent paper exists, so the repository itself is the citation (maintainer: Matheus Esteves Ferreira, IBM).

rai:dataCollection: Stitched Raman measurements of three MOF compounds (HKUST-1, Mg-MOF74, ZIF-8); WITec UHTS300S, 531.970/632.810 nm excitation, 1-2 mW, 100 accumulations x 0.5 s, 63x objective, measured 2023-02-14 to 2023-04-27.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Peak normalization to max = 1.0 as deposited; the Mg-MOF74 export is additionally background-subtracted (labelled '(Sub BG) (Norm)', 989 negative points). The loader linearly interpolates the two native grids (1,806- and 2,768-point) onto the common 0-3,997 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,998 points); no baseline correction, smoothing or other preprocessing is applied.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The sample identity of each spectrum is the MOF compound itself (HKUST-1, Mg-MOF74, ZIF-8), as named in the deposit's folders and README; the labels are derived from the deposit, not re-curated for this benchmark.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All samples are inorganic MOF compounds.
rai:dataBiases: Single facility (IBM), but the three compounds were measured under different conditions (532 nm at 1 mW for HKUST-1, 633 nm at 1 mW for Mg-MOF74, 532 nm at 2 mW for ZIF-8) - Raman intensities depend on excitation wavelength and power, and the Mg-MOF74 export is background-subtracted (989 negative points) while the other two are not, so cross-compound intensity comparisons are confounded. One stitched spectrum per compound, so there is no replicate structure and no within-class variance.
rai:dataLimitations: One stitched spectrum per compound (3 samples) - a reference set, not a CV-learnable classification; mixed excitation wavelengths (532/633 nm) and powers (1-2 mW); inconsistent per-file background subtraction; peak normalization to 1.0 removes absolute intensity information; the CDLA-Sharing-1.0 license is share-alike (commercial use allowed, derivative works must carry the same license).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Materials-science reference data for MOF compounds (HKUST-1, Mg-MOF-74, ZIF-8 - candidate gas-sensing and CO2-capture materials); no human or medical use.
rai:dataUseCases: Reference spectra for spectral matching and few-shot / augmentation use; single-compound characterization; not suitable for CV-based classification (one spectrum per class).
